CommunityApplications.Profile:
Game server containers for Unraid, built on the SteamCMD server framework.
This repository currently maintains the Deceive Inc. Dedicated Server container. It installs SteamCMD, downloads the Deceive Inc. Dedicated Server (Steam App ID 5007710) with an anonymous login, and runs it. Server settings live in a TripwireServer.ini that is kept outside the SteamCMD-managed files, so game updates never revert your configuration.
Support is handled through the GitHub issue tracker linked below. Please include the container log from the point of startup when reporting a problem.
